# DSH Environment Manager
A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that gives every session a shared, queryable view of enterprise envi
ronments, services, deployments and operation-to-Skill bindings.
Works in DSH Web and Desktop.
> 中文简介：这是一个 DSH 插件，让每个会话都能按需读取企业运行环境、服务目录、部署实例、分层规则以及操作与 Skill 的绑定关系。
## What it does

- **Environment Registry** — hosts, clusters, logical roles, access endpoints, host
accounts and log

in audit records in one record.
- **Service Catalog** — Git URL, default branch, build tool, artifac

t and rule profile references.
- **Deployment Binding** — which service runs where, as `native`, `do

cker` or `kubernetes`, with instance-level variables.
- **Rule Resolver** — layered, field-level ove

rrides with full provenance: every value explains where it came from and what influenced it.
- **Ope
ration Skill Router** — maps an operation (deploy, redeploy, collect-logs, …) to exactly one bound S

kill, detecting conflicts and enforcing approval policy.
- **Session Context** — a per-session defau

lt environment that never leaks into another session.
- **Discovery Skill** — a profile-wide `dsh-en

v-manager` Skill registers with the plugin and
makes the registry discoverable from any workspace in

the same profile; its full workflow
loads only when invoked.
- **Memory Bridge** — a contract for f
eeding scoped, redacted operation records into the DSH memory plugin (P1).
## Status

**Phase 1 of the environment/plane model and Phase 1.1 of the K8s node/execution model are
implement
ed and installed in the `desktop` profile.**

- 102 Vitest tests pass; `npm run check` (typecheck + build + tests + client syntax)
emits the commi

tted `lib/` tree.
- Twelve `env_*` tools, the same-origin `/env-manager/api` route and the sidebar/m

ain panel
are implemented.
- One environment is one complete network and one configuration page. Man

agement,
business, database and expansion are **role views** over the same `hosts[]`; a node
serving

two planes is one host with two roles.
- The environment detail page is split into overview, all no

des, one tab per plane, login
records, Kubernetes/clusters, endpoints and YAML. Plane tabs filter th

e same node
collection.
- `New environment` creates only the environment shell and seeds the four st

andard roles.
Nodes are added inside the environment, individually or by batch import.
- Add/edit no

de supports multiple roles, a machine kind (`vm`, `physical`, K8s all-in-one,
K8s worker, Pod host),

command access (`ssh`, `kubectl`, `docker`) and an optional login
credential. K8s kinds reference a

cluster; a Pod host is the machine reached with
`docker exec`, not one record per Pod. Batch import

(`IP,name,roles,port,user`) creates
generic VM nodes and never accepts passwords. Node search cover

s id, name, IP, platform,
admin user, role, kind, access, cluster, account username and web login UR

L.
- Accounts can carry a web login URL and username for a management or business console.
`Add web

login` opens the account form with protocol `web`; `Edit account` can change the
URL or rotate the p

assword. A password is written to the DSH credential service, never to
YAML.
- The Kubernetes/cluste

rs tab creates and edits cluster metadata (kind, topology, API
endpoint, namespaces, credential refe

rence) and derives node counts from `clusterRef`.
- Passwords are written to the DSH credential serv

ice; YAML keeps only
`DSH_ENV_MANAGER_<ENVIRONMENT>_<ACCOUNT>` refs.
- **环境 (Environments) is the de

fault tab**, and the persistent header **新增环境**

## How agents discover the registry

The plugin ships a **discovery Skill** named `dsh-env-manager` as part of the same bundle.
It is not
a separate `SKILL.md`, and it is not installed separately.
How it works:

1. `apply()` registers the Skill through `ctx.skills.register()` from the plugin's
unscoped context.

DSH files it into the global Skill layer for the current profile.
2. The Skill catalog carries only

the name, description and `whenToUse`. That description
is the **proactive mention** that lets a ne

w workspace discover the registry.
3. The full workflow body is loaded only when the model or user i

nvokes the Skill. It tells
the agent to use `env_list` / `env_find` first, then `env_set_context`, `

env_resolve`,
`env_resolve_operation` (which also returns related experiences), and — for explicit
e

xecution bindings — `env_operate` / `env_experience`; for bulk onboarding, backup or
migration it al

so points at `env_import` / `env_export`.
4. The plugin does **not** inject a global system-prompt s

ection. Unrelated coding sessions
do not receive environment-manager instructions.
5. The registrati

on is created inside the plugin effect, so disabling or uninstalling the
plugin also removes the Ski

ll.
6. `registerSkill: false` in the plugin config suppresses the entry without affecting the
tools

egisterSkill: false` in the plugin config suppresses the entry without affecting the
tools or panel.
Scope and limits:

- **Same DSH profile:** every workspace, including a new empty one, sees the Skill in its
catalog; n

o workspace `AGENTS.md` is required. This was verified from an empty temporary
workspace.
- **Differ

ent profile or machine:** the Skill is not shared; install the bundle there.
- The Skill is **discov

ery, not execution**. It does not deploy, restart or collect logs.
Those actions still need an `oper

ationBinding` that points to an execution Skill.
- A catalog entry is a trigger surface, not a hard

guarantee. Critical operations must still
be enforced in the execution Skill or tool layer.
- Becaus

e the Skill is registered by the plugin, its content is versioned with the plugin;
there is no works

stered by the plugin, its content is versioned with the plugin;
there is no workspace copy to drift.

## Add an environment

1. Open **环境管理器** (Environment Manager); it opens on the **环境 (Environments)** tab.
2. Click **新增环境*

* (New environment) in the panel header. The same action is available
from any other tab.
3. Fill in

the environment name, optional id, category and description. The four standard
planes are created a

utomatically. Click **创建环境** (Create environment).
4. Open the new environment. Use **全部节点** (All no

des) or a plane tab, then
**添加节点** (Add node). A node may carry several roles.
5. To register many n

odes, use **批量导入** (Batch import):
